g.text: Baseline: hard 0.015s/lap, medium 0.05, soft 0.10; medium and soft are 0.20s and 0.35s quicker than a new hard. Fuel effect: 0.07s/lap.

g.text: Dirty air costs 0.25s/lap within 2s; passing requires a 0.35s/lap advantage and time crossing. Safety Car: one shared, fixed-duration window.
